source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of standard candles (PDF 172).

blocks.text: Astronomy (sitaron aur aasman ka ilm) mein stars aur galaxies tak ke faasle napna bohat zaroori hai, kyunke isi se hum universe (kainat) ki structure (banawat) aur us ka expansion (phailna) samajhte hain.

blocks.title: Standard candles
blocks.text: Standard candles woh astronomical objects (aasmani cheezen) hain jin ki asal chamak (intrinsic brightness, yani luminosity) pehle se maloom hoti hai. Yeh cosmic faasle napne ke aham tools hain.

Standard candle zameen se kitna roshan nazar aata hai (apparent magnitude, yani nazar aane wali chamak) aur asal mein kitna roshan hai — in dono ka comparison (muqabla) kar ke astronomers roshni ke inverse-square law se us ka faasla nikal lete hain: F = L/4πd² se d = √(L/4πF). Standard candles ki misalein Cepheid variable stars aur Type Ia supernovae hain. Dono ki luminosity pehle se predict ki ja sakti hai (andaza lagaya ja sakta hai), is liye yeh faasla batane wale reliable (bharose ke qabil) nishan hain.

blocks.alt: Teen rows; har row mein daen taraf mombatti (point source) aur baen taraf phailti lines. Pehli: r par aik panel (I) jis se 16 photons guzarte hain. Doosri: r (I) aur 2r (I/4) par panels; 2r wala panel chaar khanon A ka, aur aik neele khane se 4 photons. Teesri: r, 2r, 3r, 4r par I, I/4, I/9, I/16 aur 1, 4, 9, 16 khane A; 4r par neele khane se 1 photon.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.2: standard candle se faasla napne ka tareeqa (kitab ki Figure 21.2 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Detector ka area A har jagah aik jaisa hai. r par is mein se 16 photons, 2r par 4 aur 4r par sirf 1 photon guzarta hai, kyunke wahi roshni 4, phir 16 khanon par phail jati hai (I, I/4, I/16). Agar star ki asal chamak maloom ho (standard candle) to photons gin kar faasla nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Standard candles ka idea 1910 ke saalon se hai, jab Henrietta Swan Leavitt ne dekha ke Cepheid variable stars aik maloom pattern mein pulse karte hain (roshni barhti ghatti hai). Un ke kaam ne cosmic faasle aur universe ka size napne ki foundation (bunyaad) rakhi. Standard candles na hotin to hamein yeh bhi pata na hota ke universe kitna bara hai.

blocks.title: Solved example (hal shuda misal, izafi)
blocks.problem: 1.0 × 10³⁰ W luminosity wala Cepheid star zameen par 1.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻² flux deta hai. Is ka faasla maloom karein.
steps: F = L/4πd² ko d ke liye solve karein: d = √(L/4πF)

blocks.prompt: Do stars barabar roshan nazar aate hain. Aik standard candle hai jis ki asal chamak maloom hai; doosre ki nahi. Agar standard candle zyada door ho to doosre star ki asal chamak ke bare mein kya keh sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Doosra star qareeb hai lekin utna hi roshan nazar aata hai, is liye us ki asal chamak (luminosity) standard candle se kam hai. Kitni kam: dono ke faaslon ki ratio (nisbat) ke square ke hisaab se (L ∝ d², jab F barabar ho).

items: Standard candles: maloom luminosity wale objects (Cepheid variables, Type Ia supernovae).
Napa gaya flux F aur maloom L se faasla: d = √(L/4πF).
